# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 46 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 39 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_046_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 46

**1** Jesus said: "From Adam [адам] to John the Baptist [іоханнес пвапті стнс], among those born of women [сhіме], no one has arisen who surpasses [жосе] John the Baptist that his eyes [вал] should not be lowered.

**2** Yet I said: whoever among you becomes a little child [шнре коуі] will know [соун] the kingdom and will surpass John."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *адам*: Adam; the beginning of human history
- *іоханнес пвапті стнс*: John the Baptist
- *жосе*: to be exalted, to surpass, to be higher than
- *шнре коуі*: little child; the child-motif again
- cf. Matt 11:11; Luke 7:28 — "Among those born of women no one has arisen greater than John the Baptist; yet the one who is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he"
- Thomas's version: "his eyes should not be lowered" — an idiom meaning he should not avert his gaze; John's stature is so great he need not be humbled
- The one who becomes a child SURPASSES even John

---
